verdicts.evidence: lines 449, 593, 608, 612-641, 649-660, 672-711, 375-378, 527: every button (Try again, Send invite, Invite again, Dismiss, Remove, Keep on team, Remove from team, Save name) has a listener that calls the api or changes the view as labelled.

lines 432-445, 457-470, 714-733: name, members, seat count and notifications all come from api.getTeam; table body and lists start empty in the HTML (252, 270); no hardcoded sample values or placeholder text.
lines 601-606, 280: the remove confirmation names the member and the team in its title and states the consequence, so the step shows what it depends on.
lines 223-233, 259-264: the forms have two inputs and one input, single step, single-line text; role and notification controls save at once. No task meets the threshold.
lines 228, 576: invite role preselects Member (lower privilege) and resets to it. Lines 605-606: dialog focus goes to 'Keep on team', so Enter does not remove.
Brief lists six occasional tasks with none dominant; the screen is a settings page with three sections (lines 217-271), not built around one frequent task.

lines 217-271: sections are Members (invite, roles, remove), Team name, Email notifications, all in the brief. Seat count (460) informs inviting. Last active column (511-520) is a data column, not an added section or widget.
line 231: 'Send invite' is the only .primary button on the page. Save name (262), Remove (525), notice buttons (239-240) and both dialog buttons (283-284) are plain or danger-text secondary.
lines 78, 283-284, 525, 606: Remove and 'Remove from team' use outlined .btn.danger (red text, not filled); focus starts on 'Keep on team'; row Remove sits alone in the last column.

lines 356-365: buttons are aria-disabled only while their own request runs. Lines 488-489, 524: owner has no role select or Remove (absent). Line 460: when seats are full the reason is in text by the invite form.
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
lines 201-286 and all script strings: visible text is headings, labels, statuses and messages about the team only; nothing mentions implementation, mock data or the brief.

line 280: 'They lose access at once. You can invite them again later.' sits in the remove confirmation. Line 460: seats-full note appears only when full, beside the invite form. No other notes or callouts.
No text narrates the interface. Only guidance is the empty-state line 254 'Invite the first person by email.' and one-line field errors at their controls (561-562, 677).
lines 203-204, 219-220, 258-260: header context line is the team name (data), Members has a seat count; no subtitle or helper text restates a heading or label.
All strings (209-211, 254, 280, 460, 558-562, 577, 585, 622, 637, 698, 704) are factual; no greetings, slogans, superlatives or exclamation marks in text.

Labels: 'Try again' (212, 375), 'Send invite' (231), 'Invite again', 'Dismiss' (239-240), 'Save name' (262), 'Keep on team', 'Remove from team' (283-284), row 'Remove' (525). All verbs; no OK/Submit/Yes.

lines 337-338: role and notification keys are mapped to 'Owner', 'Weekly digest' etc, with a humanising fallback (718). Dates formatted (341, 517); null last active shows 'Never' (519). No ids or codes shown.

lines 211, 558-562, 581-586, 622, 704: each error names the problem and next step (e.g. 'Could not send the invite to x. Check your connection and try again.'). e.message and codes are never rendered.

Error strings (211, 407, 503, 558-562, 585, 622, 677, 704, 726) use 'Could not', 'Enter', 'Not saved'; no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', capitals or exclamation marks in text. The '!' at 108 is a CSS icon glyph.
lines 254, 461-462: with zero members the table is hidden and 'No one is on this team yet. Invite the first person by email.' shows, directly under the invite form (223-233) which is the action.

lines 210-213, 433-438 vs 254, 461-462: failed load shows 'Could not load the team...' with Try again in place of content; no members shows a different message beside the invite form. No filter exists.

Load: 433-438 error plus retry. Invite: 580-588 message, field value kept. Rename: 701-707 value kept. Role/notification: 397-411 reverted with 'Try again'. Remove: 620-629 error inside the open dialog with the button re-enabled.

line 209: spinner and 'Loading team...' on load. Lines 356-361, 80-85: busy label and spinner on buttons. Line 392: 'Saving...' beside instant-save controls. Server calls take at most 1.5s, so no long operation.
lines 216, 440-441: #content (table, empty text, seat count) stays hidden until getTeam resolves; only the loading panel is visible. Seat count and context are empty strings before load (203, 220).

lines 125-126, 51, 118, 162: names, emails, context, notice and dialog title use overflow-wrap: anywhere. Line 516-520: null lastActive shows 'Never'. Table rows scale to any count; phone layout reflows (180-191).
lines 736-739: beforeunload calls preventDefault when the team name differs from the saved one or the invite email has text, so leaving asks first. There is no in-page navigation that discards them.
line 224: label 'Invite by email address' states the only format rule (an email address) before input; type=email at 226. Team name has no format rule beyond being non-empty.
lines 223-233, 259-264: invite email and team name are both required; the role select always has a value. No optional fields.
lines 553-564, 672-684: validation runs only in the submit handlers. Lines 551, 670: the input event only clears messages, never sets them.

lines 232, 96, 263, 102: field errors render directly under their inputs. Lines 67, 106-110: marked by a thicker border, bold text and a '!' icon as well as colour. Connection errors (234, 585) belong to no field.
lines 561-564, 580-588: on client or server rejection the email and role inputs are untouched; value is cleared only on success (575). Rename: 701-707 leaves nameInput as typed.
lines 539-544, 678-683: invalid field gets aria-invalid and focus. Lines 226, 261: inputs carry aria-describedby pointing at their error paragraphs. Errors are also announced via the live region.

lines 231, 262: submit buttons have no disabled attribute; 356-361 sets aria-disabled only during the request. Empty submit shows 'Enter an email address.' (561) or 'Enter a team name.' (684) and focuses the field.
lines 554, 566 and 674, 691: handlers return early if the button is busy and set a busy label ('Sending...', 'Saving...') with a spinner until the response. Remove confirm does the same (613, 616).

lines 566, 691, 616: busy label set synchronously on click. Line 392: 'Saving...' shown at once on select or checkbox change. Lines 427-428: retry shows the loading line at once. Line 605: Remove opens the dialog at once.

Invite: new row flashes plus message (571-578). Remove: row removed plus notice (632-638). Rename: header updates plus message (697-699). Role/toggle: 'Saved' or failure text (406-415). All failures are stated in text.

lines 577, 698, 413, 637: 'Invite sent to x' reports the send; 'Team renamed' and 'Saved' report persistence the unchanged control does not show; the removed notice carries 'Invite again'. Judged twice; rename message is the closest to redundant.

line 380: only the 'saved' status auto-clears after 4s. Failed statuses with 'Try again' (407-410), form errors (585, 704), load error (434-435) and the removed notice with its buttons (643-652) stay until acted on.

lines 507, 730: role and notification changes apply at once with no confirmation, and the same control reverses them. Removal is confirmed, but a re-invite creates a new record with access lost meanwhile, so it is judged under FB-007.

lines 603, 280, 283-284, 606: dialog asks 'Remove {name} from {team}?', states 'They lose access at once. You can invite them again later.', buttons 'Keep on team' and 'Remove from team', focus on Keep.
lines 278-286, 601-607: the only confirmation is for removing a member, which is uncommon and cuts access at once. Save, invite, role and notification changes have none.
lines 397-411: on failure instantSave resets want to saved, calls o.show(s.saved) to put the select or checkbox back, and shows 'Role not changed.' or 'Still on. Not saved.' with Try again.
lines 278-286, 527: the single modal holds one decision (remove or keep) and opens only from the row's Remove button.

lines 605-606: native dialog.showModal() with focus set to 'Keep on team'; native focus containment and Escape (blocked only while removing, 610); close returns focus to the trigger, or to the Members heading after removal (639).
lines 217-255: Members (invite form and member table) is the first and largest block; Team name and Email notifications follow below as smaller sections.
lines 202-205: header is only the team name line and h1 'Team settings', followed directly by the Members section. No hero, greeting or intro panel.
line 460: the one summary number, 'N of 12 seats used', tells the owner whether another invite is possible and what to do when full. No stat cards or charts.
The members list has no filter, search, sort or column controls.

All controls are native button, input, select, checkbox and dialog (223-286, 491, 525, 719); busy buttons use aria-disabled so they stay focusable (355-365); focus-visible outline at 59. No click-only custom widgets.

lines 106-110, 67: errors have text, bold weight, a '!' icon and a thicker border. Lines 392, 413, 407: statuses are words ('Saving...', 'Saved', 'Role not changed.'). The new-row flash (133) is backed by the invite message.

line 276: #live role=status aria-live=polite exists on load; announce() (347-352) fills it for loading, saved, sent, removed and error messages. Errors go through the polite region, not role=alert; field errors also move focus.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, custom menus, comboboxes or tabs; only native select and a native dialog.

lines 168-192: under 640px forms stack to one column, table rows become grids with visible 'Role' and 'Last active' labels, controls get 2.75rem height, dialog width is min(28rem, 100vw - 2rem) with stacked buttons (160, 178).
